g.text: One queue / Exclusive task claims / Reviewable handoffs
Task ID / owner / base SHA / reserved paths
Task record / Commit SHA / Pull request URL / Tests / Contracts / Blockers / Next action
Base: main / Ready for review when validated
If blocked: publish blocker, release or reserve the claim, and take the next eligible task.
No shared worktree, duplicate task claims, undocumented cross-agent changes, or autonomous merges.
Juno - Original project creator: Enzo Ribas. Developed with AI assistance.
